   495	    /// Appends `incoming` at `[stored ..< stored + n]` of `buffer`, growing it
   496	    /// like `KVCacheSimple` (fixed steps, capped at `maxTokens`). A buffer whose
   497	    /// dtype or non-sequence dims differ from `incoming` falls back to the old
   498	    /// exact concatenation, so promotion and shape behavior stay unchanged.
   499	    private static func write(
   500	        _ incoming: MLXArray,
   501	        into buffer: MLXArray?,
   502	        stored: Int,
   503	        maxTokens: Int
   504	    ) -> MLXArray {
   505	        let n = incoming.dim(2)
   506	        guard let buffer else {
   507	            guard n > 0 else { return prefix(incoming, 0) }
   508	            var target = grown(nil, like: incoming, stored: 0, needed: n, maxTokens: maxTokens)
   509	            target[.ellipsis, 0 ..< n, 0...] = incoming
   510	            return target
   511	        }
   512	        guard n > 0 else { return buffer }
   513	        guard buffer.ndim == 4,
   514	              buffer.dim(0) == incoming.dim(0),
   515	              buffer.dim(1) == incoming.dim(1),
   516	              buffer.dim(3) == incoming.dim(3),
   517	              buffer.dtype == incoming.dtype
   518	        else {
   519	            return concatenated([prefix(buffer, stored), incoming], axis: 2)
   520	        }
   521	        var target = buffer.dim(2) >= stored + n
   522	            ? buffer
   523	            : grown(buffer, like: incoming, stored: stored, needed: stored + n, maxTokens: maxTokens)
   524	        target[.ellipsis, stored ..< stored + n, 0...] = incoming
   525	        return target
   526	    }
   527	
   528	    private static func grown(
   529	        _ buffer: MLXArray?,
   530	        like incoming: MLXArray,
   531	        stored: Int,
   532	        needed: Int,
   533	        maxTokens: Int
   534	    ) -> MLXArray {
   535	        let capacity = PagedKVBlockLayout.grownCapacity(stored: stored, needed: needed, maxTokens: maxTokens)
   536	        let extra = MLXArray.zeros(
   537	            [incoming.dim(0), incoming.dim(1), capacity - stored, incoming.dim(3)],
   538	            dtype: incoming.dtype
   539	        )
   540	        guard let buffer, stored > 0 else { return extra }
   541	        return concatenated([prefix(buffer, stored), extra], axis: 2)
   542	    }
   543	
   544	    /// Always a new slice, never the buffer object: MLX slice assignment
   545	    /// mutates the `MLXArray` object in place, so handing out the buffer itself
   546	    /// would let a later write alias into K/V the caller still holds.
   547	    private static func prefix(_ buffer: MLXArray, _ tokens: Int) -> MLXArray {
   548	        buffer[.ellipsis, ..<tokens, 0...]
   549	    }

   551	    private static func firstBlockShape(_ buffer: MLXArray, storedTokens: Int, blockSizeTokens: Int) -> [Int] {
   552	        var shape = buffer.shape
   553	        shape[shape.count - 2] = min(blockSizeTokens, storedTokens)
   554	        return shape
   555	    }

   557	    /// Block views over the logical prefix, built only when a caller needs
   558	    /// per-block arrays (FR-PKV10 record/materialize).
   559	    private func blockViews(_ buffer: MLXArray?) -> [MLXArray] {
   560	        guard storedTokens > 0, let buffer else { return [] }
   561	        let logical = Self.prefix(buffer, storedTokens)
   562	        return PagedKVBlockLayout.blockRanges(tokens: storedTokens, blockSizeTokens: blockSizeTokens).map {
   563	            logical[.ellipsis, $0, 0...]
   564	        }
   565	    }

   567	    private static func physicalBlocks(
   568	        _ arrays: [MLXArray],
   569	        table: PagedKVBlockTable,
   570	        fullShape: [Int],
   571	        dtype: PagedKVDType
   572	    ) throws -> [Int: Data] {
   573	        let sequenceAxis = fullShape.count - 2
   574	        let outerElements = try product(fullShape.prefix(sequenceAxis))
   575	        let innerBytes = try innerBytesPerToken(shape: fullShape, dtype: dtype)
   576	        let blockOuterStride = try checkedMultiply(table.blockSizeTokens, innerBytes)
   577	        let fullBlockBytes = try checkedMultiply(outerElements, blockOuterStride)
   578	        var mappedBlocks: [Int: Data] = [:]
   579	        mappedBlocks.reserveCapacity(table.physicalBlocks.count)
   580	        for (blockIndex, array) in arrays.enumerated() {

   582	                ? table.tailValidTokenCount
   583	                : table.blockSizeTokens
   584	            var expectedShape = fullShape
   585	            expectedShape[sequenceAxis] = validTokens
   586	            guard array.shape == expectedShape,
   587	                  try pagedDType(for: array.dtype) == dtype
   588	            else {
   589	                throw PagedKVContiguousCacheBridgeError.blockTableMismatch
   590	            }
   591	            let blockData = array.asData(access: .copy)
   592	            guard blockData.shape == expectedShape,
   593	                  try pagedDType(for: blockData.dType) == dtype
   594	            else {
   595	                throw PagedKVContiguousCacheBridgeError.unsupportedDType
   596	            }

   598	                try checkedMultiply(outerElements, validTokens),
   599	                innerBytes
   600	            )
   601	            guard blockData.data.count == validBlockBytes else {
   602	                throw PagedKVContiguousCacheBridgeError.blockTableMismatch
   603	            }
   604	            var padded = Data(repeating: 0, count: fullBlockBytes)
   605	            let sourceOuterStride = try checkedMultiply(validTokens, innerBytes)
   606	            for outer in 0..<outerElements {
   607	                let sourceStart = outer * sourceOuterStride
   608	                let destinationStart = outer * blockOuterStride

   610	                    destinationStart ..< destinationStart + sourceOuterStride,
   611	                    with: blockData.data[sourceStart ..< sourceStart + sourceOuterStride]
   612	                )
   613	            }

   615	            guard mappedBlocks[physicalID] == nil else {
   616	                throw PagedKVContiguousCacheBridgeError.blockTableMismatch
   617	            }

   619	        }
   620	        guard mappedBlocks.count == table.physicalBlocks.count else {
   621	            throw PagedKVContiguousCacheBridgeError.blockTableMismatch
   622	        }
   623	        return mappedBlocks
   624	    }

   120	protocol PagedKVRuntimeCacheBridge: Sendable {
   121	    func record(caches: [PagedKVCache], binding: PagedKVStorageBinding) throws

   126	final class PagedKVRuntimeContiguousCacheBridge: PagedKVContiguousCacheBridge, PagedKVRuntimeCacheBridge, @unchecked Sendable {
   127	    private struct Record {
   128	        let version = UUID()

   130	        var table: PagedKVBlockTable
   131	        let caches: [PagedKVCache]
   132	    }
   133	
   134	    private let lock = NSLock()
   135	    private var recordsByHandle: [UUID: Record] = [:]
   136	
   137	    func record(caches: [PagedKVCache], binding: PagedKVStorageBinding) throws {
   138	        let table = binding.currentTable
   139	        try caches.forEach { cache in
   140	            try Self.validateHandle(cache.binding.handle, matches: binding.handle)
   141	            // Same offset/table/shape guards the eager host copy used to
   142	            // enforce, without the copy: that copy was ~40% of every batched
   143	            // decode window and only the FR-PKV10 materialize path reads it.
   144	            try cache.validateRecordable(table: table)
   145	        }
   146	        lock.lock()
   147	        recordsByHandle[binding.handle.handleID] = Record(
   148	            handle: binding.handle,
   149	            table: table,
   150	            caches: caches
   151	        )
   152	        lock.unlock()
   153	    }
   154	
   155	    func discard(handle: PagedKVBlockTableHandle) {
   156	        discardContiguousCache(handle: handle)
   157	    }
   158	
   159	    func discardContiguousCache(handle: PagedKVBlockTableHandle) {
   160	        lock.lock()
   161	        recordsByHandle.removeValue(forKey: handle.handleID)
   162	        lock.unlock()
   163	    }

   165	    func trimRecordedContiguousCache(
   166	        handle: PagedKVBlockTableHandle,
   167	        table: PagedKVBlockTable
   168	    ) throws {
   169	        lock.lock()
   170	        let existing = recordsByHandle[handle.handleID]
   171	        lock.unlock()
   172	        guard var record = existing else { return }
   173	        try Self.validateHandle(handle, matches: record.handle)
   174	        guard Self.isSameTableIdentity(record.table, table),
   175	              table.logicalTokenCount <= record.table.logicalTokenCount,
   176	              record.table.physicalBlocks.prefix(table.physicalBlocks.count).elementsEqual(table.physicalBlocks)
   177	        else {
   178	            throw PagedKVContiguousCacheBridgeError.blockTableMismatch
   179	        }
   180	        for cache in record.caches {
   181	            guard cache.offset == record.table.logicalTokenCount, cache.isTrimmable else {
   182	                throw PagedKVContiguousCacheBridgeError.blockTableMismatch
   183	            }
   184	        }
   185	        lock.lock()
   186	        let stillCurrent = recordsByHandle[handle.handleID]?.version == record.version
   187	        lock.unlock()
   188	        guard stillCurrent else { return }
   189	        for cache in record.caches {
   190	            let trimCount = cache.offset - table.logicalTokenCount
   191	            if trimCount > 0 {
   192	                guard cache.trim(trimCount) == trimCount else {
   193	                    discardContiguousCache(handle: handle)
   194	                    throw PagedKVContiguousCacheBridgeError.trimShortfall
   195	                }
   196	            }
   197	        }
   198	        if table.logicalTokenCount == 0 {
   199	            discardContiguousCache(handle: handle)
   200	            return
   201	        }
   202	        for cache in record.caches {
   203	            try Self.validateRecordableCache(cache, expectedHandle: handle, table: table)
   204	        }
   205	        record.table = table
   206	        lock.lock()
   207	        if recordsByHandle[handle.handleID]?.version == record.version {
   208	            recordsByHandle[handle.handleID] = record
   209	        }
   210	        lock.unlock()
   211	    }

   213	    func materializeContiguousByteCache(
   214	        handle: PagedKVBlockTableHandle,
   215	        table: PagedKVBlockTable
   216	    ) throws -> PagedKVMaterializedByteCache {
   217	        lock.lock()
   218	        let record = recordsByHandle[handle.handleID]
   219	        lock.unlock()
   220	        guard let record else { throw PagedKVContiguousCacheBridgeError.noRecordedBlocks }
   221	        try Self.validateHandle(handle, matches: record.handle)
   222	        guard table == record.table else {
   223	            throw PagedKVContiguousCacheBridgeError.blockTableMismatch
   224	        }
   225	        // Built on demand from the recorded caches, which the record keeps
   226	        // bound to its handle exactly as `reattachPagedKVCache` relies on.
   227	        // `physicalLayerBlocks` re-checks offset == table, so a cache that
   228	        // moved past the recorded table fails closed instead of returning
   229	        // bytes for a different state.
   230	        let physicalLayers = try record.caches.enumerated().map { layerIndex, cache in
   231	            try cache.physicalLayerBlocks(layerIndex: layerIndex, table: table)
   232	        }
   233	        let materializedLayers = try physicalLayers.sorted(by: { $0.layerIndex < $1.layerIndex }).map { layer in
   234	            guard layer.keyBlocks.count == table.physicalBlocks.count,
   235	                  layer.valueBlocks.count == table.physicalBlocks.count
   236	            else {
   237	                throw PagedKVContiguousCacheBridgeError.blockTableMismatch
   238	            }
   239	            let keyShape = try Self.shape(layer.keyShape, logicalTokens: table.logicalTokenCount)
   240	            let valueShape = try Self.shape(layer.valueShape, logicalTokens: table.logicalTokenCount)
   241	            return PagedKVMaterializedByteLayer(
   242	                layerIndex: layer.layerIndex,
   243	                keyShape: keyShape,
   244	                valueShape: valueShape,
   245	                dtype: layer.dtype,
   246	                logicalTokenCount: table.logicalTokenCount,
   247	                keyBytes: try Self.materializeShapedComponent(
   248	                    table: table,
   249	                    physicalBlocks: layer.keyBlocks,
   250	                    shape: keyShape,
   251	                    dtype: layer.dtype
   252	                ),
   253	                valueBytes: try Self.materializeShapedComponent(
   254	                    table: table,
   255	                    physicalBlocks: layer.valueBlocks,
   256	                    shape: valueShape,
   257	                    dtype: layer.dtype
   258	                )
   259	            )
   260	        }
   261	        return PagedKVMaterializedByteCache(handle: handle, blockTable: table, layers: materializedLayers)
   262	    }

   264	    func materializeContiguousKVCache(
   265	        handle: PagedKVBlockTableHandle,
   266	        table: PagedKVBlockTable

   269	            handle: handle,

   271	        ))
   272	    }

   274	    func reattachPagedKVCache(
   275	        handle: PagedKVBlockTableHandle,

   553	    func prefill(rows inputs: [ContinuousBatchPrefillInput]) async throws -> [ContinuousBatchPrefillOutput] {
   554	        guard beginOperation() else {
   555	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_backend_cancelled")
   556	        }
   557	        defer { endOperation() }
   558	        return try await container.perform(nonSendable: inputs) { context, inputs in
   559	            var outputs: [ContinuousBatchPrefillOutput] = []
   560	            outputs.reserveCapacity(inputs.count)
   561	            for input in inputs {
   562	                var state = self.rowState(for: input.requestID, binding: input.binding, initialOffset: input.committedKVTokenCount)
   563	                if !input.promptTokens.isEmpty {
   564	                    let prompt = MLXArray(input.promptTokens.map(Int32.init)).reshaped([1, input.promptTokens.count])
   565	                    let text = LMInput.Text(tokens: prompt)
   566	                    let output = withPreparedCache(state.caches, lengths: text.sequenceLengths) {
   567	                        context.model(text, cache: state.caches, state: state.state)
   568	                    }
   569	                    // Prefill never samples: the last prompt token is fed by the
   570	                    // first decode step. Evaluate only the caches, as
   571	                    // `LLMModel.prepare` does, so the vocabulary projection over
   572	                    // every chunk position is never computed.
   573	                    eval(state.caches)
   574	                    state.state = output.state
   575	                }
   576	                try self.setRowState(state, for: input.requestID, binding: input.binding)
   577	                outputs.append(ContinuousBatchPrefillOutput(requestID: input.requestID))
   578	            }
   579	            self.clearDecodeSession()
   580	            return outputs
   581	        }
   582	    }

   584	    func decode(rows inputs: [ContinuousBatchDecodeInput]) async throws -> [ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] {
   585	        guard !inputs.isEmpty else { return [] }
   586	        guard beginOperation() else {
   587	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_backend_cancelled")
   588	        }
   589	        defer { endOperation() }
   590	        let supportedInputs = inputs.filter(Self.supportsRowSampling)
   591	        var rowFailures = Set(inputs.map(\.requestID)).subtracting(supportedInputs.map(\.requestID))
   592	        guard !supportedInputs.isEmpty else {
   593	            return inputs.map { .rowFailure(requestID: $0.requestID) }
   594	        }
   595	
   596	        let decoded: [ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] = try await container.perform(nonSendable: supportedInputs) { context, supportedInputs in
   597	            try self.performDecode(
   598	                model: context.model,
   599	                supportedInputs: supportedInputs,
   600	                steps: 1
   601	            )
   602	        }
   603	        for outcome in decoded {
   604	            if case .rowFailure(let requestID) = outcome {
   605	                rowFailures.insert(requestID)
   606	            }
   607	        }
   608	        let byID: [String: ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] = Dictionary(
   609	            uniqueKeysWithValues: decoded.map { ($0.requestID, $0) }
   610	        )
   611	        return inputs.map { input in
   612	            if rowFailures.contains(input.requestID) { return .rowFailure(requestID: input.requestID) }
   613	            if let outcome = byID[input.requestID] { return outcome }
   614	            return .rowFailure(requestID: input.requestID)
   615	        }
   616	    }
   617	
   618	    /// Lockstep decode of `steps` tokens inside one `container.perform`; each
   619	    /// row samples with its own parameters (`ContinuousBatchRowSampler`).
   620	    /// Returns every sampled token in generation order so the scheduler can
   621	    /// apply stop/stream/receipt without dropping intermediates. The throughput
   622	    /// harness uses the same seam.
   623	    func decodeLockstepWindow(
   624	        rows inputs: [ContinuousBatchDecodeInput],
   625	        steps: Int
   626	    ) async throws -> [ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] {
   627	        guard steps >= 1 else { return [] }
   628	        guard !inputs.isEmpty else { return [] }
   629	        guard beginOperation() else {
   630	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_backend_cancelled")
   631	        }
   632	        defer { endOperation() }
   633	        let supportedInputs = inputs.filter(Self.supportsRowSampling)
   634	        var rowFailures = Set(inputs.map(\.requestID)).subtracting(supportedInputs.map(\.requestID))
   635	        guard !supportedInputs.isEmpty else {
   636	            return inputs.map { .rowFailure(requestID: $0.requestID) }
   637	        }
   638	        let decoded: [ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] = try await container.perform(nonSendable: supportedInputs) { context, supportedInputs in
   639	            try self.performDecode(
   640	                model: context.model,
   641	                supportedInputs: supportedInputs,
   642	                steps: steps
   643	            )
   644	        }
   645	        for outcome in decoded {
   646	            if case .rowFailure(let requestID) = outcome {
   647	                rowFailures.insert(requestID)
   648	            }
   649	        }
   650	        let byID: [String: ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] = Dictionary(
   651	            uniqueKeysWithValues: decoded.map { ($0.requestID, $0) }
   652	        )
   653	        return inputs.map { input in
   654	            if rowFailures.contains(input.requestID) { return .rowFailure(requestID: input.requestID) }
   655	            if let outcome = byID[input.requestID] { return outcome }
   656	            return .rowFailure(requestID: input.requestID)
   657	        }
   658	    }

   665	    func installRetainedPagedKVCache(
   666	        requestID: String,
   667	        handoff: PagedKVPagedCacheHandoff,
   668	        binding: PagedKVStorageBinding,
   669	        recurrentCheckpoint: RecurrentStateCheckpoint?
   670	    ) async throws {
   671	        let unavailable = ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_retained_hybrid_cache_unavailable")
   672	        guard cacheKinds.contains(.recurrentMamba) else {
   673	            guard recurrentCheckpoint == nil else { throw unavailable }
   674	            let state = RowState(caches: handoff.caches, state: nil)
   675	            try setRowState(state, for: requestID, binding: binding)
   676	            return
   677	        }
   678	        // SPEC-038 AC-26 hybrid cached turn: attention layers come from the
   679	        // handoff, recurrent layers from the checkpoint taken at exactly the
   680	        // handoff length. Never a zero recurrent state.
   681	        guard let recurrentCheckpoint,
   682	              recurrentCheckpoint.tokenCount == handoff.logicalTokenCount
   683	        else {
   684	            throw unavailable
   685	        }
   686	        // Validate every recurrent layer's state shape before anything is
   687	        // installed, so a malformed checkpoint fails admission (which releases
   688	        // the reattached blocks) instead of resuming prefill on invalid state.
   689	        let recurrentIndices = cacheKinds.indices.filter { cacheKinds[$0] == .recurrentMamba }
   690	        let layouts = recurrentCheckpoint.states.mapValues { slots in
   691	            slots.map { RecurrentStateSlotLayout(shape: $0.shape, dtype: $0.dtype) }
   692	        }
   693	        guard Self.recurrentCheckpointLayoutIsValid(layouts, recurrentLayerIndices: recurrentIndices) else {
   694	            throw unavailable
   695	        }
   696	        var attention = handoff.caches.makeIterator()
   697	        var caches: [KVCache] = []
   698	        for (index, kind) in cacheKinds.enumerated() {
   699	            switch kind {
   700	            case .pagedAttention:
   701	                guard let cache = attention.next() else { throw unavailable }
   702	                caches.append(cache)
   703	            case .recurrentMamba:
   704	                guard let state = recurrentCheckpoint.states[index], !state.isEmpty else { throw unavailable }
   705	                let cache = MambaCache()
   706	                cache.state = state
   707	                caches.append(cache)
   708	            }
   709	        }
   710	        guard attention.next() == nil else { throw unavailable }
   711	        try setRowState(RowState(caches: caches, state: nil), for: requestID, binding: binding)
   712	    }

   714	    func commitTerminalKV(_ input: ContinuousBatchTerminalKVCommitInput) async throws {
   715	        guard beginOperation() else {
   716	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_backend_cancelled")
   717	        }
   718	        defer { endOperation() }
   719	        try await container.perform(nonSendable: input) { context, input in
   720	            var state = self.rowState(
   721	                for: input.requestID,
   722	                binding: input.binding,
   723	                initialOffset: input.committedKVTokenCount
   724	            )
   725	            let tokenInput = MLXArray([Int32(input.currentToken)]).reshaped([1, 1])
   726	            let text = LMInput.Text(tokens: tokenInput)
   727	            let output = withPreparedCache(state.caches, lengths: text.sequenceLengths) {
   728	                context.model(text, cache: state.caches, state: state.state)
   729	            }
   730	            eval(output.logits)
   731	            state.state = output.state
   732	            try self.setRowState(state, for: input.requestID, binding: input.binding)
   733	            self.invalidateDecodeSession(containing: input.requestID)
   734	        }
   735	    }

   737	    func snapshotRecurrentState(requestID: String, tokenCount: Int) async -> RecurrentStateCheckpoint? {
   738	        guard cacheKinds.contains(.recurrentMamba), beginOperation() else { return nil }
   739	        defer { endOperation() }
   740	        return await container.perform { _ in
   741	            let row = self.existingRowState(for: requestID)
   742	            guard let row else { return nil }
   743	            var states: [Int: [MLXArray]] = [:]
   744	            for (index, kind) in self.cacheKinds.enumerated() where kind == .recurrentMamba {
   745	                guard row.caches.indices.contains(index) else { return nil }
   746	                let state = row.caches[index].state
   747	                guard !state.isEmpty else { return nil }
   748	                states[index] = state
   749	            }
   750	            eval(states.values.flatMap { $0 })
   751	            return RecurrentStateCheckpoint(tokenCount: tokenCount, states: states)
   752	        }
   753	    }

  1120	    private func makeBatchedCaches(from rowCaches: [[KVCache]]) throws -> [PagedKVSharedLayerBatch] {
  1121	        guard let layerCount = rowCaches.first?.count,
  1122	              rowCaches.allSatisfy({ $0.count == layerCount }),
  1123	              layerCount == cacheKinds.count
  1124	        else {
  1125	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_cache_layout")
  1126	        }
  1127	        return try (0 ..< layerCount).map { layerIndex in
  1128	            switch cacheKinds[layerIndex] {
  1129	            case .pagedAttention:
  1130	                let rows = rowCaches.compactMap { $0[layerIndex] as? PagedKVCache }
  1131	                guard rows.count == rowCaches.count else {
  1132	                    throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_cache_layout")
  1133	                }
  1134	                let cache = PagedKVBatchLayerCache(rowCaches: rows)
  1135	                return PagedKVSharedLayerBatch(
  1136	                    cache: cache,
  1137	                    validateBatchStateClosure: {},
  1138	                    syncRowsFromBatchClosure: { cache.syncRowsFromBatch() },
  1139	                    writebackCompiledInnerStateClosure: { compiledState, targets in
  1140	                        try cache.writebackCompiledInnerState(compiledState, targets: targets)
  1141	                    }
  1142	                )
  1143	            case .recurrentMamba:
  1144	                let rows = rowCaches.compactMap { $0[layerIndex] as? MambaCache }
  1145	                guard rows.count == rowCaches.count else {
  1146	                    throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_cache_layout")
  1147	                }
  1148	                let cache = MambaCache()
  1149	                try Self.packMambaRows(rows, into: cache)
  1150	                return PagedKVSharedLayerBatch(
  1151	                    cache: cache,
  1152	                    validateBatchStateClosure: {
  1153	                        guard cache.state.count == 2,
  1154	                              cache.state.allSatisfy({ $0.ndim >= 1 && $0.dim(0) == rows.count })
  1155	                        else {
  1156	                            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_mamba_state")
  1157	                        }
  1158	                    },
  1159	                    syncRowsFromBatchClosure: { Self.syncMambaRows(from: cache, into: rows) },
  1160	                    writebackCompiledInnerStateClosure: { compiledState, targets in
  1161	                        guard targets.count == rows.count else {
  1162	                            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_cache_layout")
  1163	                        }
  1164	                        cache.state = compiledState
  1165	                        Self.syncMambaRows(from: cache, into: rows)
  1166	                        try Self.packMambaRows(rows, into: cache)
  1167	                    }
  1168	                )
  1169	            }
  1170	        }
  1171	    }
  1172	
  1173	    private static func pagedAttentionCaches(in caches: [KVCache]) -> [PagedKVCache] {
  1174	        caches.compactMap { $0 as? PagedKVCache }
  1175	    }

  1177	    private static func packMambaRows(_ rows: [MambaCache], into batch: MambaCache) throws {
  1178	        let rowStates = rows.map(\.state)
  1179	        let slotCount = rowStates.map(\.count).max() ?? 0
  1180	        guard slotCount > 0 else { return }
  1181	        for slot in 0 ..< slotCount {
  1182	            guard let first = rowStates.first(where: { $0.indices.contains(slot) })?[slot] else {
  1183	                throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_cache_layout")
  1184	            }
  1185	            // A one-token joining row has not run prefill, so its recurrent
  1186	            // slots are empty. Qwen35 initializes those slots with zeros.
  1187	            let slotArrays = rowStates.map { states in
  1188	                states.indices.contains(slot)
  1189	                    ? states[slot]
  1190	                    : MLXArray.zeros(first.shape, dtype: first.dtype)
  1191	            }
  1192	            guard slotArrays.allSatisfy({
  1193	                      $0.ndim >= 1
  1194	                          && $0.dim(0) == 1
  1195	                          && Array($0.shape.dropFirst()) == Array(first.shape.dropFirst())
  1196	                          && $0.dtype == first.dtype
  1197	                  })
  1198	            else {
  1199	                throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_cache_layout")
  1200	            }
  1201	            batch[slot] = concatenated(slotArrays, axis: 0)
  1202	        }
  1203	    }
  1204	
  1205	    private static func syncMambaRows(from batch: MambaCache, into rows: [MambaCache]) {
  1206	        let batchedState = batch.state
  1207	        guard batchedState.count == 2,
  1208	              batchedState.allSatisfy({ $0.ndim >= 1 && $0.dim(0) == rows.count })
  1209	        else { return }
  1210	        for rowIndex in rows.indices {
  1211	            rows[rowIndex].state = batchedState.map { array in
  1212	                return array[rowIndex ..< rowIndex + 1, .ellipsis]
  1213	            }
  1214	            rows[rowIndex].offset = batch.offset
  1215	        }
  1216	    }
  1217	}
  1218	
  1219	/// Per-row compiled-decode writeback. Compile-with-state can grow the batched
  1220	/// KV past each row's committed target; slicing must keep each row's own
  1221	/// prefix, not a batch-wide minimum.
  1222	enum PagedKVCompiledWriteback {
  1223	    static func rowSlices(
  1224	        keysValues compiledState: [MLXArray],
  1225	        targets: [Int]
  1226	    ) throws -> [(MLXArray, MLXArray)] {
  1227	        guard compiledState.count == 2 else {
  1228	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_cache_layout")
  1229	        }
  1230	        let keys = compiledState[0]
  1231	        let values = compiledState[1]
  1232	        guard keys.ndim == 4,
  1233	              values.ndim == 4,
  1234	              keys.dim(0) == targets.count,
  1235	              values.dim(0) == targets.count,
  1236	              keys.dim(2) == values.dim(2),
  1237	              !targets.isEmpty
  1238	        else {
  1239	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_cache_layout")
  1240	        }
  1241	        let compiledSequence = keys.dim(2)
  1242	        return try targets.enumerated().map { rowIndex, target in
  1243	            guard target > 0, compiledSequence >= target else {
  1244	                throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_cache_layout")
  1245	            }
  1246	            return (
  1247	                keys[rowIndex ..< rowIndex + 1, 0..., 0..<target, 0...],
  1248	                values[rowIndex ..< rowIndex + 1, 0..., 0..<target, 0...]
  1249	            )
  1250	        }
  1251	    }
  1252	}

  1254	private struct PagedKVSharedLayerBatch {
  1255	    let cache: KVCache
  1256	    let validateBatchStateClosure: () throws -> Void
  1257	    let syncRowsFromBatchClosure: () -> Void
  1258	    let writebackCompiledInnerStateClosure: ([MLXArray], [Int]) throws -> Void
  1259	
  1260	    func innerState() -> [MLXArray] {
  1261	        cache.innerState()
  1262	    }
  1263	
  1264	    func validateBatchState() throws {
  1265	        try validateBatchStateClosure()
  1266	    }
  1267	
  1268	    func syncRowsFromBatch() {
  1269	        syncRowsFromBatchClosure()
  1270	    }
  1271	
  1272	    func writebackCompiledInnerState(_ compiledState: [MLXArray], targets: [Int]) throws {
  1273	        try writebackCompiledInnerStateClosure(compiledState, targets)
  1274	    }
  1275	}

  1277	private final class PagedKVBatchLayerCache: KVCache, @unchecked Sendable {
  1278	    private let rowCaches: [PagedKVCache]
  1279	    private var preparedLengths: [Int]?
  1280	    /// `[B, H, capacity, D]` batch buffers; only `[..<length]` is logical. Rows
  1281	    /// shorter than `length` are zero past their own stored tokens, exactly
  1282	    /// the padding `concatenatePadded` produced.
  1283	    private var keys: MLXArray?
  1284	    private var values: MLXArray?
  1285	    private var length = 0
  1286	    /// Each row's `mutationCount` right after this batch last wrote it. The
  1287	    /// in-place ragged path is used only while every row still matches, so a
  1288	    /// row changed elsewhere (bridge trim, state writeback) forces a rebuild.
  1289	    private var rowMutationCounts: [Int]?
  1290	    /// Live lockstep sequence length. When set, `update` concatenates on the
  1291	    /// batch tensors instead of looping per row (required for `MLX.compile()`).
  1292	    private var batchedOffset: Int?
  1293	
  1294	    init(rowCaches: [PagedKVCache]) {
  1295	        self.rowCaches = rowCaches
  1296	        packFromRows()
  1297	    }
  1298	
  1299	    var offset: Int {
  1300	        batchedOffset ?? (rowCaches.map(\.offset).min() ?? 0)
  1301	    }
  1302	
  1303	    var ropeOffset: RoPEOffset {
  1304	        .batch(MLXArray(preUpdateOffsets.map(Int32.init)))
  1305	    }
  1306	
  1307	    var maxSize: Int? {
  1308	        rowCaches.compactMap(\.maxSize).min()
  1309	    }
  1310	
  1311	    func innerState() -> [MLXArray] {
  1312	        guard let keys, let values else { return [] }
  1313	        return [Self.prefix(keys, length), Self.prefix(values, length)]
  1314	    }
  1315	
  1316	    func syncRowsFromBatch() {
  1317	        // Only the lockstep-concat path (equal-length rows) writes KV to the
  1318	        // batch tensors alone; it is the one that sets `batchedOffset`. Ragged
  1319	        // rows take the per-row `update` path, which already wrote each row's
  1320	        // own cache and left the batch tensors padded to the longest row.
  1321	        // Copying those padded tensors back would give every shorter row the
  1322	        // batch-max length and fail the next window with
  1323	        // `paged_kv_block_table_mismatch` (Studio, 2+ concurrent rows).
  1324	        guard batchedOffset != nil else { return }
  1325	        let state = innerState()
  1326	        guard state.count == 2 else { return }
  1327	        let keys = state[0]
  1328	        let values = state[1]
  1329	        guard keys.ndim == 4,
  1330	              values.ndim == 4,
  1331	              keys.dim(0) == rowCaches.count,
  1332	              values.dim(0) == rowCaches.count
  1333	        else {
  1334	            return
  1335	        }
  1336	        for (rowIndex, cache) in rowCaches.enumerated() {
  1337	            cache.state = [
  1338	                keys[rowIndex ..< rowIndex + 1, 0..., 0..., 0...],
  1339	                values[rowIndex ..< rowIndex + 1, 0..., 0..., 0...]
  1340	            ]
  1341	        }
  1342	        batchedOffset = nil
  1343	    }
  1344	
  1345	    func writebackCompiledInnerState(_ compiledState: [MLXArray], targets: [Int]) throws {
  1346	        let slices = try PagedKVCompiledWriteback.rowSlices(
  1347	            keysValues: compiledState,
  1348	            targets: targets
  1349	        )
  1350	        for (rowIndex, cache) in rowCaches.enumerated() {
  1351	            cache.state = [slices[rowIndex].0, slices[rowIndex].1]
  1352	        }

   533	    convenience init(
   534	        container: ModelContainer,
   535	        descriptor: PagedKVDescriptor,
   536	        layerCount: Int,
   537	        cacheKinds: [CacheKind]? = nil,
   538	        contiguousCacheBridge: (any PagedKVRuntimeCacheBridge)? = nil,
   539	        compiledDecode: Bool = false
   540	    ) {
   541	        self.init(
   542	            container: container,
   543	            blockSizeTokens: descriptor.blockSizeTokens,
   544	            maxPhysicalBlocks: descriptor.maxPhysicalBlocks,
   545	            poolEpoch: descriptor.poolEpoch,
   546	            layerCount: layerCount,
   547	            cacheKinds: cacheKinds,
   548	            contiguousCacheBridge: contiguousCacheBridge,
   549	            compiledDecode: compiledDecode
   550	        )
   551	    }
   552	
   553	    func prefill(rows inputs: [ContinuousBatchPrefillInput]) async throws -> [ContinuousBatchPrefillOutput] {
   554	        guard beginOperation() else {
   555	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_backend_cancelled")
   556	        }
   557	        defer { endOperation() }
   558	        return try await container.perform(nonSendable: inputs) { context, inputs in
   559	            var outputs: [ContinuousBatchPrefillOutput] = []
   560	            outputs.reserveCapacity(inputs.count)
   561	            for input in inputs {
   562	                var state = self.rowState(for: input.requestID, binding: input.binding, initialOffset: input.committedKVTokenCount)
   563	                if !input.promptTokens.isEmpty {
   564	                    let prompt = MLXArray(input.promptTokens.map(Int32.init)).reshaped([1, input.promptTokens.count])
   565	                    let text = LMInput.Text(tokens: prompt)
   566	                    let output = withPreparedCache(state.caches, lengths: text.sequenceLengths) {
   567	                        context.model(text, cache: state.caches, state: state.state)
   568	                    }
   569	                    // Prefill never samples: the last prompt token is fed by the
   570	                    // first decode step. Evaluate only the caches, as
   571	                    // `LLMModel.prepare` does, so the vocabulary projection over
   572	                    // every chunk position is never computed.
   573	                    eval(state.caches)
   574	                    state.state = output.state
   575	                }
   576	                try self.setRowState(state, for: input.requestID, binding: input.binding)
   577	                outputs.append(ContinuousBatchPrefillOutput(requestID: input.requestID))
   578	            }
   579	            self.clearDecodeSession()
   580	            return outputs
   581	        }
   582	    }
   583	
   584	    func decode(rows inputs: [ContinuousBatchDecodeInput]) async throws -> [ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] {
   585	        guard !inputs.isEmpty else { return [] }
   586	        guard beginOperation() else {
   587	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_backend_cancelled")
   588	        }
   589	        defer { endOperation() }
   590	        let supportedInputs = inputs.filter(Self.supportsRowSampling)
   591	        var rowFailures = Set(inputs.map(\.requestID)).subtracting(supportedInputs.map(\.requestID))
   592	        guard !supportedInputs.isEmpty else {
   593	            return inputs.map { .rowFailure(requestID: $0.requestID) }
   594	        }
   595	
   596	        let decoded: [ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] = try await container.perform(nonSendable: supportedInputs) { context, supportedInputs in
   597	            try self.performDecode(
   598	                model: context.model,
   599	                supportedInputs: supportedInputs,
   600	                steps: 1
   601	            )
   602	        }
   603	        for outcome in decoded {
   604	            if case .rowFailure(let requestID) = outcome {
   605	                rowFailures.insert(requestID)
   606	            }
   607	        }
   608	        let byID: [String: ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] = Dictionary(
   609	            uniqueKeysWithValues: decoded.map { ($0.requestID, $0) }
   610	        )
   611	        return inputs.map { input in
   612	            if rowFailures.contains(input.requestID) { return .rowFailure(requestID: input.requestID) }
   613	            if let outcome = byID[input.requestID] { return outcome }
   614	            return .rowFailure(requestID: input.requestID)
   615	        }
   616	    }
   617	
   618	    /// Lockstep decode of `steps` tokens inside one `container.perform`; each
   619	    /// row samples with its own parameters (`ContinuousBatchRowSampler`).
   620	    /// Returns every sampled token in generation order so the scheduler can
   621	    /// apply stop/stream/receipt without dropping intermediates. The throughput
   622	    /// harness uses the same seam.
   623	    func decodeLockstepWindow(
   624	        rows inputs: [ContinuousBatchDecodeInput],
   625	        steps: Int
   626	    ) async throws -> [ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] {
   627	        guard steps >= 1 else { return [] }
   628	        guard !inputs.isEmpty else { return [] }
   629	        guard beginOperation() else {
   630	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_backend_cancelled")
   631	        }
   632	        defer { endOperation() }
   633	        let supportedInputs = inputs.filter(Self.supportsRowSampling)
   634	        var rowFailures = Set(inputs.map(\.requestID)).subtracting(supportedInputs.map(\.requestID))
   635	        guard !supportedInputs.isEmpty else {
   636	            return inputs.map { .rowFailure(requestID: $0.requestID) }
   637	        }
   638	        let decoded: [ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] = try await container.perform(nonSendable: supportedInputs) { context, supportedInputs in
   639	            try self.performDecode(
   640	                model: context.model,
   641	                supportedInputs: supportedInputs,
   642	                steps: steps
   643	            )
   644	        }
   645	        for outcome in decoded {
   646	            if case .rowFailure(let requestID) = outcome {
   647	                rowFailures.insert(requestID)
   648	            }
   649	        }
   650	        let byID: [String: ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] = Dictionary(
   651	            uniqueKeysWithValues: decoded.map { ($0.requestID, $0) }
   652	        )
   653	        return inputs.map { input in
   654	            if rowFailures.contains(input.requestID) { return .rowFailure(requestID: input.requestID) }
   655	            if let outcome = byID[input.requestID] { return outcome }
   656	            return .rowFailure(requestID: input.requestID)
   657	        }
   658	    }

   660	    func finish(requestID: String) {
   661	        invalidateDecodeSession(containing: requestID)
   662	        removeRowState(for: requestID, discardRecordedCache: false)
   663	    }
   664	
   665	    func installRetainedPagedKVCache(
   666	        requestID: String,
   667	        handoff: PagedKVPagedCacheHandoff,
   668	        binding: PagedKVStorageBinding,
   669	        recurrentCheckpoint: RecurrentStateCheckpoint?
   670	    ) async throws {
   671	        let unavailable = ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_retained_hybrid_cache_unavailable")
   672	        guard cacheKinds.contains(.recurrentMamba) else {
   673	            guard recurrentCheckpoint == nil else { throw unavailable }
   674	            let state = RowState(caches: handoff.caches, state: nil)
   675	            try setRowState(state, for: requestID, binding: binding)
   676	            return
   677	        }
   678	        // SPEC-038 AC-26 hybrid cached turn: attention layers come from the
   679	        // handoff, recurrent layers from the checkpoint taken at exactly the
   680	        // handoff length. Never a zero recurrent state.
   681	        guard let recurrentCheckpoint,
   682	              recurrentCheckpoint.tokenCount == handoff.logicalTokenCount
   683	        else {
   684	            throw unavailable
   685	        }
   686	        // Validate every recurrent layer's state shape before anything is
   687	        // installed, so a malformed checkpoint fails admission (which releases
   688	        // the reattached blocks) instead of resuming prefill on invalid state.
   689	        let recurrentIndices = cacheKinds.indices.filter { cacheKinds[$0] == .recurrentMamba }
   690	        let layouts = recurrentCheckpoint.states.mapValues { slots in
   691	            slots.map { RecurrentStateSlotLayout(shape: $0.shape, dtype: $0.dtype) }
   692	        }
   693	        guard Self.recurrentCheckpointLayoutIsValid(layouts, recurrentLayerIndices: recurrentIndices) else {
   694	            throw unavailable
   695	        }
   696	        var attention = handoff.caches.makeIterator()
   697	        var caches: [KVCache] = []
   698	        for (index, kind) in cacheKinds.enumerated() {
   699	            switch kind {
   700	            case .pagedAttention:
   701	                guard let cache = attention.next() else { throw unavailable }
   702	                caches.append(cache)
   703	            case .recurrentMamba:
   704	                guard let state = recurrentCheckpoint.states[index], !state.isEmpty else { throw unavailable }
   705	                let cache = MambaCache()
   706	                cache.state = state
   707	                caches.append(cache)
   708	            }
   709	        }
   710	        guard attention.next() == nil else { throw unavailable }
   711	        try setRowState(RowState(caches: caches, state: nil), for: requestID, binding: binding)
   712	    }
   713	
   714	    func commitTerminalKV(_ input: ContinuousBatchTerminalKVCommitInput) async throws {
   715	        guard beginOperation() else {
   716	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_backend_cancelled")
   717	        }
   718	        defer { endOperation() }
   719	        try await container.perform(nonSendable: input) { context, input in
   720	            var state = self.rowState(
   721	                for: input.requestID,
   722	                binding: input.binding,
   723	                initialOffset: input.committedKVTokenCount
   724	            )
   725	            let tokenInput = MLXArray([Int32(input.currentToken)]).reshaped([1, 1])
   726	            let text = LMInput.Text(tokens: tokenInput)
   727	            let output = withPreparedCache(state.caches, lengths: text.sequenceLengths) {
   728	                context.model(text, cache: state.caches, state: state.state)
   729	            }
   730	            eval(output.logits)
   731	            state.state = output.state
   732	            try self.setRowState(state, for: input.requestID, binding: input.binding)
   733	            self.invalidateDecodeSession(containing: input.requestID)
   734	        }
   735	    }
   736	
   737	    func snapshotRecurrentState(requestID: String, tokenCount: Int) async -> RecurrentStateCheckpoint? {
   738	        guard cacheKinds.contains(.recurrentMamba), beginOperation() else { return nil }
   739	        defer { endOperation() }
   740	        return await container.perform { _ in
   741	            let row = self.existingRowState(for: requestID)
   742	            guard let row else { return nil }
   743	            var states: [Int: [MLXArray]] = [:]
   744	            for (index, kind) in self.cacheKinds.enumerated() where kind == .recurrentMamba {
   745	                guard row.caches.indices.contains(index) else { return nil }
   746	                let state = row.caches[index].state
   747	                guard !state.isEmpty else { return nil }
   748	                states[index] = state
   749	            }
   750	            eval(states.values.flatMap { $0 })
   751	            return RecurrentStateCheckpoint(tokenCount: tokenCount, states: states)
   752	        }
   753	    }
   754	
   755	    /// Reuses the FR-PKV10 materialize path on a throwaway bridge that records
   756	    /// only this row's paged caches, so nothing outlives the call.
   757	    func materializeSerialConversationCache(
   758	        requestID: String,
   759	        binding: PagedKVStorageBinding,
   760	        tokenCount: Int,
   761	        recurrentCheckpoints: [RecurrentStateCheckpoint]
   762	    ) async throws -> ContinuousBatchSerialConversationCache? {
   763	        guard cacheKinds.contains(.recurrentMamba), !recurrentCheckpoints.isEmpty else { return nil }
   764	        guard beginOperation() else {
   765	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_backend_cancelled")
   766	        }
   767	        defer { endOperation() }
   768	        return try await container.perform { _ in
   769	            self.invalidateDecodeSession(containing: requestID)
   770	            let row = self.existingRowState(for: requestID)
   771	            guard let row, row.caches.count == self.cacheKinds.count else { return nil }
   772	            let bridge = PagedKVRuntimeContiguousCacheBridge()
   773	            try bridge.record(caches: Self.pagedAttentionCaches(in: row.caches), binding: binding)
   774	            var handoff = try bridge.materializeContiguousKVCache(handle: binding.handle, table: binding.currentTable)
   775	            try handoff.trim(toLogicalTokens: tokenCount)
   776	            var attention = handoff.caches.makeIterator()
   777	            var layers: [KVCache] = []
   778	            for kind in self.cacheKinds {
   779	                switch kind {
   780	                case .pagedAttention:
   781	                    guard let cache = attention.next() else {
   782	                        throw PagedKVContiguousCacheBridgeError.blockTableMismatch
   783	                    }
   784	                    layers.append(cache)
   785	                case .recurrentMamba:
   786	                    layers.append(MambaCache())
   787	                }
   788	            }
   789	            return ContinuousBatchSerialConversationCache(
   790	                layers: layers,
   791	                recurrentCheckpoints: recurrentCheckpoints,
   792	                tokenCount: tokenCount
   793	            )
   794	        }
   795	    }
   796	
   797	    func cancelInFlight() async {
   798	        await withCheckedContinuation { continuation in
   799	            lock.lock()
   800	            cancelRequested = true
   801	            decodeSession = nil
   802	            let handlesToDiscard = rows.compactMap { Self.pagedAttentionCaches(in: $0.value.caches).first?.binding.handle }
   803	            rows.removeAll()
   804	            if activeOperations == 0 {
   805	                lock.unlock()
   806	                handlesToDiscard.forEach { contiguousCacheBridge?.discardContiguousCache(handle: $0) }
   807	                continuation.resume()
   808	            } else {
   809	                cancellationWaiters.append(continuation)
   810	                lock.unlock()
   811	                handlesToDiscard.forEach { contiguousCacheBridge?.discardContiguousCache(handle: $0) }
   812	            }
   813	        }
   814	    }
   815	
   816	    private func beginOperation() -> Bool {
   817	        lock.lock()
   818	        defer { lock.unlock() }
   819	        guard !cancelRequested else { return false }
   820	        activeOperations += 1
   821	        return true
   822	    }
   823	
   824	    private func endOperation() {
   825	        let waiters: [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>]
   826	        lock.lock()
   827	        activeOperations = max(0, activeOperations - 1)
   828	        if cancelRequested && activeOperations == 0 {
   829	            waiters = cancellationWaiters
   830	            cancellationWaiters.removeAll()
   831	        } else {
   832	            waiters = []
   833	        }
   834	        lock.unlock()
   835	        for waiter in waiters {
   836	            waiter.resume()
   837	        }
   838	    }
   839	
   840	    private func rowState(
   841	        for requestID: String,
   842	        binding: PagedKVStorageBinding,
   843	        initialOffset: Int
   844	    ) -> RowState {
   845	        lock.lock()
   846	        defer { lock.unlock() }
   847	        if let existing = rows[requestID] {
   848	            return existing
   849	        }
   850	        return RowState(
   851	            caches: cacheKinds.map { kind in
   852	                switch kind {
   853	                case .pagedAttention:
   854	                    PagedKVCache(
   855	                        blockSizeTokens: blockSizeTokens,
   856	                        maxPhysicalBlocks: maxPhysicalBlocks,
   857	                        poolEpoch: poolEpoch,
   858	                        binding: binding,
   859	                        initialOffset: initialOffset,
   860	                        reconstructViaGather: false
   861	                    )
   862	                case .recurrentMamba:
   863	                    MambaCache()
   864	                }
   865	            },
   866	            state: nil
   867	        )
   868	    }
   869	
   870	    private func existingRowState(for requestID: String) -> RowState? {
   871	        lock.lock()
   872	        defer { lock.unlock() }
   873	        return rows[requestID]
   874	    }
   875	
   876	    private func setRowState(
   877	        _ state: RowState,
   878	        for requestID: String,
   879	        binding: PagedKVStorageBinding
   880	    ) throws {
   881	        lock.lock()
   882	        let cancelledBeforeRecord = cancelRequested
   883	        lock.unlock()
   884	        guard !cancelledBeforeRecord else {
   885	            contiguousCacheBridge?.discardContiguousCache(handle: binding.handle)
   886	            return
   887	        }
   888	        try contiguousCacheBridge?.record(caches: Self.pagedAttentionCaches(in: state.caches), binding: binding)
   889	        lock.lock()
   890	        if !cancelRequested {
   891	            rows[requestID] = state
   892	            lock.unlock()
   893	        } else {
   894	            lock.unlock()
   895	            contiguousCacheBridge?.discardContiguousCache(handle: binding.handle)
   896	        }
   897	    }
   898	
   899	    private func removeRowState(for requestID: String, discardRecordedCache: Bool = true) {
   900	        lock.lock()
   901	        let removed = rows.removeValue(forKey: requestID)
   902	        lock.unlock()
   903	        if discardRecordedCache, let handle = removed.flatMap({ Self.pagedAttentionCaches(in: $0.caches).first?.binding.handle }) {
   904	            contiguousCacheBridge?.discard(handle: handle)
   905	        }
   906	    }
   907	
   908	    private func performDecode(
   909	        model: any LanguageModel,
   910	        supportedInputs: [ContinuousBatchDecodeInput],
   911	        steps: Int
   912	    ) throws -> [ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome] {
   913	        let decodeSteps = max(1, steps)
   914	        var rowStates = supportedInputs.map {
   915	            self.rowState(
   916	                for: $0.requestID,
   917	                binding: $0.binding,
   918	                initialOffset: $0.committedKVTokenCount
   919	            )
   920	        }
   921	        if supportedInputs.count > 1 && rowStates.contains(where: { $0.state != nil }) {
   922	            return supportedInputs.map { ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome.rowFailure(requestID: $0.requestID) }
   923	        }
   924	
   925	        let requestIDs = supportedInputs.map(\.requestID)
   926	        var session = copyDecodeSession()
   927	        let batchedCaches: [PagedKVSharedLayerBatch]
   928	        if let existing = session, existing.requestIDs == requestIDs {
   929	            batchedCaches = existing.batchedCaches
   930	        } else {
   931	            session?.batchedCaches.forEach { $0.syncRowsFromBatch() }
   932	            batchedCaches = try makeBatchedCaches(from: rowStates.map(\.caches))
   933	            session = DecodeSession(
   934	                requestIDs: requestIDs,
   935	                batchedCaches: batchedCaches,
   936	                compiledCaches: [],
   937	                compiledStep: nil
   938	            )
   939	        }
   940	        let cachesAsKV = batchedCaches.map(\.cache)
   941	        let canCompile = compiledDecode
   942	            && cacheKinds.allSatisfy({ $0 == .pagedAttention })
   943	            && rowStates.allSatisfy({ $0.state == nil })
   944	            && cachesAsKV.allSatisfy { !$0.innerState().isEmpty }
   945	
   946	        let sampledByRow: [[Int]]
   947	        if canCompile {
   948	            var compiledCaches: [KVCache]
   949	            let step: CompiledDecodeStep
   950	            if let existingStep = session?.compiledStep,
   951	               let existing = session?.compiledCaches,
   952	               existing.count == batchedCaches.count,
   953	               !existing.isEmpty
   954	            {
   955	                compiledCaches = existing
   956	                step = existingStep
   957	            } else {
   958	                compiledCaches = model.newCache(parameters: nil)
   959	                guard compiledCaches.count == batchedCaches.count else {
   960	                    throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_cache_layout")
   961	                }
   962	                for index in compiledCaches.indices {
   963	                    let packed = batchedCaches[index].innerState()
   964	                    if packed.count == 2 {
   965	                        compiledCaches[index].state = packed
   966	                    }
   967	                }
   968	                eval(compiledCaches)
   969	                step = CompiledDecodeStep(model: model, cache: compiledCaches, enabled: true)
   970	                session?.compiledCaches = compiledCaches
   971	                session?.compiledStep = step
   972	            }
   973	            var current = MLXArray(supportedInputs.map { Int32($0.currentToken) }).reshaped([supportedInputs.count, 1])
   974	            eval(current)
   975	            var collected: [[Int]] = supportedInputs.map { _ in [] }
   976	            for stepIndex in 0 ..< decodeSteps {
   977	                let logits = step.step(current)
   978	                current = ContinuousBatchRowSampler.sample(
   979	                    logits: logits[0..., -1, 0...],
   980	                    rows: Self.samplerRows(supportedInputs, step: stepIndex)
   981	                ).reshaped([supportedInputs.count, 1])
   982	                eval(current)
   983	                let stepTokens = current.asArray(Int.self)
   984	                guard stepTokens.count == supportedInputs.count else {
   985	                    throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_logits_shape")
   986	                }
   987	                for index in supportedInputs.indices {
   988	                    collected[index].append(stepTokens[index])
   989	                }
   990	            }
   991	            Stream().synchronize()
   992	            sampledByRow = collected
   993	            let targets = supportedInputs.map(\.targetKVTokenCount)
   994	            for index in compiledCaches.indices {
   995	                try batchedCaches[index].writebackCompiledInnerState(
   996	                    compiledCaches[index].innerState(),
   997	                    targets: targets
   998	                )
   999	            }
  1000	        } else {
  1001	            session?.compiledStep = nil
  1002	            var currentTokens = supportedInputs.map(\.currentToken)
  1003	            var collected: [[Int]] = supportedInputs.map { _ in [] }
  1004	            for stepIndex in 0 ..< decodeSteps {
  1005	                let tokenInput = MLXArray(currentTokens.map(Int32.init)).reshaped([supportedInputs.count, 1])
  1006	                let text = LMInput.Text(tokens: tokenInput)
  1007	                let output = withPreparedCache(cachesAsKV, lengths: text.sequenceLengths) {
  1008	                    model(text, cache: cachesAsKV, state: supportedInputs.count == 1 ? rowStates[0].state : nil)
  1009	                }
  1010	                try batchedCaches.forEach { try $0.validateBatchState() }
  1011	                let stepSampled = ContinuousBatchRowSampler.sample(
  1012	                    logits: output.logits[0..., -1, 0...],
  1013	                    rows: Self.samplerRows(supportedInputs, step: stepIndex)
  1014	                ).asArray(Int.self)
  1015	                guard stepSampled.count == supportedInputs.count else {
  1016	                    throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_logits_shape")
  1017	                }
  1018	                if supportedInputs.count == 1 {
  1019	                    rowStates[0].state = output.state
  1020	                } else if output.state != nil {
  1021	                    return supportedInputs.map { ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome.rowFailure(requestID: $0.requestID) }
  1022	                }
  1023	                for index in supportedInputs.indices {
  1024	                    collected[index].append(stepSampled[index])
  1025	                }
  1026	                currentTokens = stepSampled
  1027	            }
  1028	            sampledByRow = collected
  1029	            batchedCaches.forEach { $0.syncRowsFromBatch() }
  1030	        }
  1031	
  1032	        guard sampledByRow.count == supportedInputs.count,
  1033	              sampledByRow.allSatisfy({ $0.count == decodeSteps }) else {
  1034	            throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported("continuous_batching_invalid_logits_shape")
  1035	        }
  1036	        storeDecodeSession(session)
  1037	        for (index, input) in supportedInputs.enumerated() {
  1038	            try self.setRowState(rowStates[index], for: input.requestID, binding: input.binding)
  1039	        }
  1040	        return zip(supportedInputs, sampledByRow).map { input, tokens in
  1041	            ContinuousBatchDecodeOutcome.output(ContinuousBatchDecodeOutput(
  1042	                requestID: input.requestID,
  1043	                tokens: tokens
  1044	            ))
  1045	        }
  1046	    }
  1047	
  1048	    private func copyDecodeSession() -> DecodeSession? {
  1049	        lock.lock()
  1050	        defer { lock.unlock() }
  1051	        return decodeSession
  1052	    }
  1053	
  1054	    private func storeDecodeSession(_ session: DecodeSession?) {
  1055	        lock.lock()
  1056	        decodeSession = session
  1057	        lock.unlock()
  1058	    }
  1059

  1982	        }

  2403	                        throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.unsupported(
  2404	                            "continuous_batching_retained_hybrid_cache_unavailable"
  2405	                        )

  2408	                        retained,
  2409	                        conversationKey: request.conversationKey,
  2410	                        trimToLogicalTokens: request.cachedPromptTokens,
  2411	                        maxLogicalTokens: reservation.maxLogicalTokens
  2412	                    )
  2413	                    admissionHandle = handle
  2414	                    let binding = try await allocator.binding(for: handle)
  2415	                    let handoff = try contiguousCacheBridge.reattachPagedKVCache(
  2416	                        handle: handle,
  2417	                        table: binding.currentTable
  2418	                    )
  2419	                    try await backend.installRetainedPagedKVCache(
  2420	                        requestID: request.id,
  2421	                        handoff: handoff,
  2422	                        binding: binding,
  2423	                        recurrentCheckpoint: recurrentCheckpoint
  2424	                    )
  2425	                    prefillCursor = request.cachedPromptTokens
  2426	                } else {
  2427	                    handle = try await allocator.allocate(
  2428	                        conversationKey: schedulerConversationKey(for: request),
  2429	                        initialCapacityTokens: reservation.initialCapacityTokens,
  2430	                        maxLogicalTokens: reservation.maxLogicalTokens,
  2431	                        initialTokens: 0
  2432	                    )
  2433	                    admissionHandle = handle
  2434	                    prefillCursor = 0
  2435	                }
  2436	                admittingRequests.removeValue(forKey: request.id)

  2440	                        request,
  2441	                        status: released ? .rejected : .requestFailed,
  2442	                        errorCode: released ? "continuous_batching_draining" : "continuous_batching_cleanup_failed"
  2443	                    )
  2444	                    if !released { return madeProgress }

  2446	                } else if cancelledIDs.remove(request.id) != nil {
  2447	                    let released = await release(handle)
  2448	                    await finishQueued(
  2449	                        request,
  2450	                        status: released ? .cancelled : .requestFailed,
  2451	                        errorCode: released ? "request_cancelled" : "continuous_batching_cleanup_failed"
  2452	                    )
  2453	                    if !released { return madeProgress }
  2454	                    continue
  2455	                }
  2456	                record(.promptHeadroomReserved)
  2457	                record(.accepted)
  2458	                try? FileHandle.standardError.write(contentsOf: Data("event=batching_admitted action=scheduler_admitted\n".utf8))
  2459	                activePrompt[request.id] = Row(
  2460	                    request: request,
  2461	                    handle: handle,
  2462	                    currentToken: request.promptTokens.last ?? 0,
  2463	                    generatedTokens: [],
  2464	                    outputTokens: [],
  2465	                    pendingOutputTokens: [],
  2466	                    prefillCursor: prefillCursor,
  2467	                    snapshot: configuration.snapshot,
  2468	                    // Stored checkpoints on this prompt's own positions are a
  2469	                    // prefix of it, so they carry forward (as on the serial path).
  2470	                    recurrentCheckpoints: request.retainedRecurrentCheckpoints.filter {
  2471	                        request.recurrentCheckpointPositions.contains($0.tokenCount)
  2472	                    }
  2473	                )
  2474	                promptOrder.append(request.id)

  2476	            } catch PagedKVAllocatorError.capacityExceeded {

  2478	                if draining {
  2479	                    await finishQueued(request, status: .rejected, errorCode: "continuous_batching_draining")
  2480	                } else if activeDecode.isEmpty && activePrompt.isEmpty && admittingRequests.isEmpty {
  2481	                    record(.poolCapacityRejected)
  2482	                    await finishQueued(
  2483	                        request,
  2484	                        status: .rejected,
  2485	                        errorCode: "continuous_batching_pool_capacity_exhausted"
  2486	                    )
  2487	                } else {

  2496	                    if !released { return madeProgress }
  2497	                } else if let retained = request.retainedPagedKVSequence {

  2501	            } catch {

  2515	    private func runPrefillStep() async -> Bool {
  2516	        let selectedIDs = Array(promptOrder.prefix(configuration.maxPrefillRowsPerIteration))
  2517	        guard !selectedIDs.isEmpty else { return false }
  2518	
  2519	        var prepared: [(row: Row, input: ContinuousBatchPrefillInput, chunkCount: Int)] = []
  2520	        var madeProgress = false
  2521	        for id in selectedIDs {
  2522	            guard let row = activePrompt[id] else { continue }
  2523	            let prefixTokenCount = row.request.promptTokens.count - 1
  2524	            if row.prefillCursor >= prefixTokenCount {
  2525	                await transitionPrefilledRow(row)
  2526	                madeProgress = true
  2527	                if cleanupFailedClosed { return true }
  2528	                continue
  2529	            }
  2530	            var end = min(prefixTokenCount, row.prefillCursor + configuration.maxPromptChunkTokens)
  2531	            // A chunk ends exactly on the next recurrent checkpoint so its state
  2532	            // can be snapshotted there.
  2533	            if let checkpoint = pendingRecurrentCheckpointPositions(for: row).first(where: { $0 > row.prefillCursor }) {
  2534	                end = min(end, checkpoint)
  2535	            }
  2536	            let chunk = Array(row.request.promptTokens[row.prefillCursor..<end])
  2537	            do {
  2538	                _ = try await allocator.extend(row.handle, by: chunk.count)
  2539	            } catch {
  2540	                record(.localExtensionFailed)
  2541	                ContinuousBatchingPolicy.logPrefillFailed(error)
  2542	                _ = removePromptRow(id)
  2543	                let released = await release(row.handle)
  2544	                finish(
  2545	                    row,
  2546	                    status: .requestFailed,
  2547	                    errorCode: released
  2548	                        ? "continuous_batching_prefill_extend_failed"
  2549	                        : "continuous_batching_cleanup_failed"
  2550	                )
  2551	                if !released { return true }
  2552	                continue
  2553	            }
  2554	            do {
  2555	                prepared.append((
  2556	                    row,
  2557	                    ContinuousBatchPrefillInput(
  2558	                        requestID: id,
  2559	                        promptTokens: chunk,
  2560	                        binding: try await allocator.binding(for: row.handle),
  2561	                        promptTokenOffset: row.prefillCursor,
  2562	                        committedKVTokenCount: row.prefillCursor,
  2563	                        targetKVTokenCount: end,
  2564	                        isFinalChunk: end == prefixTokenCount
  2565	                    ),
  2566	                    chunk.count
  2567	                ))
  2568	            } catch {
  2569	                record(.localPreparationFailed)
  2570	                ContinuousBatchingPolicy.logPrefillFailed(error)
  2571	                _ = removePromptRow(id)
  2572	                let released = await release(row.handle)
  2573	                finish(
  2574	                    row,
  2575	                    status: .requestFailed,
  2576	                    errorCode: released
  2577	                        ? "continuous_batching_prefill_prepare_failed"
  2578	                        : "continuous_batching_cleanup_failed"
  2579	                )
  2580	                if !released { return true }
  2581	            }
  2582	        }
  2583	        guard !prepared.isEmpty else { return madeProgress }
  2584	
  2585	        prefillCalls += 1
  2586	        let outputs: [ContinuousBatchPrefillOutput]
  2587	        do {
  2588	            outputs = try await backend.prefill(rows: prepared.map(\.input))
  2589	            try validatePrefillOutputStructure(outputs, expectedRequestIDs: prepared.map { $0.row.request.id })
  2590	        } catch {
  2591	            record(.prefillFailed)
  2592	            ContinuousBatchingPolicy.logPrefillFailed(error)
  2593	            for item in prepared {
  2594	                guard let row = removePromptRow(item.row.request.id) else { continue }
  2595	                let released = await release(row.handle)
  2596	                finish(
  2597	                    row,
  2598	                    status: .requestFailed,
  2599	                    errorCode: released
  2600	                        ? "continuous_batching_prefill_failed"
  2601	                        : "continuous_batching_cleanup_failed"
  2602	                )
  2603	                if !released { return true }
  2604	            }
  2605	            return true
  2606	        }
  2607	
  2608	        let byID = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: outputs.map { ($0.requestID, $0) })
  2609	        for item in prepared {
  2610	            let id = item.row.request.id
  2611	            guard var row = activePrompt[id], byID[id] != nil else { continue }
  2612	            if cancelledIDs.remove(id) != nil {
  2613	                _ = removePromptRow(id)
  2614	                let released = await release(row.handle)
  2615	                finish(row, status: released ? .cancelled : .requestFailed, errorCode: released
  2616	                    ? "request_cancelled"
  2617	                    : "continuous_batching_cleanup_failed")
  2618	                if !released { return true }
  2619	                continue
  2620	            }
  2621	            row.prefillCursor += item.chunkCount
  2622	            if pendingRecurrentCheckpointPositions(for: row).contains(row.prefillCursor) {
  2623	                if let checkpoint = await backend.snapshotRecurrentState(requestID: id, tokenCount: row.prefillCursor) {
  2624	                    row.recurrentCheckpoints.append(checkpoint)
  2625	                }
  2626	                guard activePrompt[id] != nil else { continue }
  2627	                // A cancel that arrived while the snapshot was suspended only
  2628	                // recorded the ID; honour it here, before the row can
  2629	                // materialize a cache or move on to decode.
  2630	                if cancelledIDs.remove(id) != nil {
  2631	                    _ = removePromptRow(id)
  2632	                    let released = await release(row.handle)
  2633	                    finish(row, status: released ? .cancelled : .requestFailed, errorCode: released
  2634	                        ? "request_cancelled"
  2635	                        : "continuous_batching_cleanup_failed")
  2636	                    if !released { return true }
  2637	                    continue
  2638	                }
  2639	            }
  2640	            if row.prefillCursor == row.request.promptTokens.count - 1 {
  2641	                activePrompt[id] = row
  2642	                await transitionPrefilledRow(row)
  2643	                if cleanupFailedClosed { return true }
  2644	            } else {
  2645	                activePrompt[id] = row
  2646	            }
  2647	        }
  2648	        return true
  2649	    }

  2662	    private func failRemainingAfterCleanupFailure() async {
  2663	        while !waiting.isEmpty {
  2664	            await finishQueued(
  2665	                waiting.removeFirst(),
  2666	                status: .requestFailed,
  2667	                errorCode: "continuous_batching_scheduler_failed_closed"
  2668	            )
  2669	        }
  2670	        for id in promptOrder {
  2671	            guard let row = activePrompt.removeValue(forKey: id) else { continue }
  2672	            _ = await release(row.handle)
  2673	            finish(row, status: .requestFailed, errorCode: "continuous_batching_scheduler_failed_closed")
  2674	        }
  2675	        promptOrder.removeAll()
  2676	        for id in activeDecode.keys.sorted() {
  2677	            guard let row = activeDecode.removeValue(forKey: id) else { continue }
  2678	            _ = await release(row.handle)
  2679	            finish(row, status: .requestFailed, errorCode: "continuous_batching_scheduler_failed_closed")
  2680	        }
  2681	        cancelledIDs.removeAll()
  2682	    }

  3003	    private func retainTerminalCache(for row: Row, targetLogicalTokens: Int) async -> ContinuousBatchRetainedCache? {
  3004	        let trimmedKey = row.request.conversationKey.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)
  3005	        guard !trimmedKey.isEmpty, let contiguousCacheBridge else { return nil }
  3006	        var retainedSequence: PagedKVRetainedSequence?
  3007	        do {
  3008	            let binding = try await allocator.binding(for: row.handle)
  3009	            if targetLogicalTokens > binding.currentTable.logicalTokenCount {
  3010	                _ = try await allocator.extend(
  3011	                    row.handle,
  3012	                    by: targetLogicalTokens - binding.currentTable.logicalTokenCount
  3013	                )
  3014	                let targetBinding = try await allocator.binding(for: row.handle)
  3015	                guard let terminalToken = row.generatedTokens.last else {
  3016	                    throw ContinuousBatchSchedulerError.requestFailed("continuous_batching_terminal_kv_commit_missing_token")
  3017	                }
  3018	                try await backend.commitTerminalKV(ContinuousBatchTerminalKVCommitInput(
  3019	                    requestID: row.request.id,
  3020	                    currentToken: terminalToken,
  3021	                    binding: targetBinding,
  3022	                    blockTable: targetBinding.currentTable,
  3023	                    committedKVTokenCount: binding.currentTable.logicalTokenCount,
  3024	                    targetKVTokenCount: targetLogicalTokens
  3025	                ))
  3026	            } else if targetLogicalTokens < binding.currentTable.logicalTokenCount {
  3027	                _ = try await allocator.trim(row.handle, toLogicalTokens: targetLogicalTokens)
  3028	            }
  3029	            let retained = try await allocator.retain(row.handle)
  3030	            retainedSequence = retained
  3031	            let retainedBinding = try await allocator.binding(for: retained.handle)
  3032	            let handoff = try contiguousCacheBridge.reattachPagedKVCache(
  3033	                handle: retained.handle,
  3034	                table: retainedBinding.currentTable
  3035	            )
  3036	            return ContinuousBatchRetainedCache(
  3037	                retainedSequence: retained,
  3038	                layers: handoff.caches,
  3039	                recurrentCheckpoints: row.recurrentCheckpoints
  3040	            )
  3041	        } catch {
  3042	            if let retainedSequence {
  3043	                do {
  3044	                    _ = try await allocator.reattach(retainedSequence, conversationKey: trimmedKey)
  3045	                } catch {
  3046	                    cleanupFailedClosed = true
  3047	                    record(.cleanupFailed)
  3048	                }
  3049	            }
  3050	            return nil
  3051	        }
  3052	    }
